verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs show it plugging into two protocols owned by other parties: OpenAI's Agentic Commerce Protocol on ChatGPT and Google's Universal Commerce Protocol on Google AI Mode/Gemini. They also name catalog partners (Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics, Shopware) that connect to its services. However, PayPal's own surface (Store Sync and the merchant-hosted cart API with PayPal-issued JWTs) is a PayPal-specific, form-gated integration rather than an open protocol that independent parties implement, and every claim is vendor-sourced. Missing for 10: evidence of independent third parties implementing PayPal's own cart/Store Sync protocol, independent corroboration of partner implementations, and details of how far the partner integrations go beyond the names listed.
